lines.zh: 我贴着暖水的沙底滑，像一张翻面的饼。
lines.en: I slide over warm sand like a flipped pancake.

lines.zh: 扁得没有侧面，我只能侧着看你。
lines.en: So flat I have no side; I can only watch you sideways.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在沙上划，留下一圈浅印。
lines.en: My fins rake the sand and leave a shallow ring.

lines.zh: 温水推我走，我懒得自己动。
lines.en: Warm water pushes me along; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 别追我的影子，它比饼还薄。
lines.en: Do not chase my shadow; it is thinner than a pancake.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，沙子就盖住了我的背。
lines.en: One flick of my tail buries my back in sand.

lines.zh: 暖流是我的路，冷水我一步不去。
lines.en: Warm currents are my road; I never enter cold water.

lines.zh: 我一生都在海底摊平，从不站起来。
lines.en: All my life I lie flat on the seabed and never rise.

lines.zh: 我的边沿卷起来，那是在拐弯。
lines.en: When my rim curls up, that is me turning.

lines.zh: 沙粒卡在我的褶里，走起来有点响。
lines.en: Grains lodge in my folds and rattle as I go.

lines.zh: 我漂得比走得多，反正到得一样。
lines.en: I drift more than I walk, and arrive the same.

lines.zh: 独自一条，走到哪里都不碰同类。
lines.en: Solitary, I never brush against my own kind.

lines.zh: 我翻个身，就换了个方向。
lines.en: I roll over once and face a new direction.

lines.zh: 海草扫过我的背，我当它是在挠。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my back and I take it as scratching.

lines.zh: 我在暖水里打了个转，沙扬起来。
lines.en: I spin in the warm water and sand lifts.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过礁缝，边沿先过去。
lines.en: I work through a reef gap, edge first.

lines.zh: 我摊在沙上，等阳光把水烘温。
lines.en: I spread on the sand and wait for sun to warm the water.

lines.zh: 没人喂我，我就慢慢凉下去。
lines.en: With no one feeding me, I slowly cool.

lines.zh: 气泡从我边沿冒出来，我懒得动。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my rim and I do not stir.

lines.zh: 我在数上面游过的鱼影。
lines.en: I keep count of fish shadows drifting above me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸就是两片鳃轻轻开合。
lines.en: My breathing is two gills opening and closing softly.

lines.zh: 这片暖水是我的煎锅，我躺着。
lines.en: This warm water is my griddle, and I lie in it.

lines.zh: 有只海龟看了我很久，又走了。
lines.en: A turtle stared at me a long while, then left.

lines.zh: 我把身体埋进沙里，只剩一条边。
lines.en: I bury my body, leaving only one rim exposed.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见盐在水里化开。
lines.en: It is so quiet I hear salt dissolving in the water.

lines.zh: 我找到一块滑石，贴上就不想动了。
lines.en: I find a smooth stone and stick to it, unwilling to move.

lines.zh: 我偶尔想起天气贝壳还在谁手里。
lines.en: Now and then I wonder whose hand holds the weather shell.

lines.zh: 头顶的光斑移过去，我跟着挪一寸。
lines.en: A patch of light shifts; I move an inch after it.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴自己拍了两下，没原因。
lines.en: My tail flaps twice for no reason at all.

lines.zh: 等一条虫游近，我的日子才有事。
lines.en: Only when a worm swims near does my day have business.

lines.zh: 你的两只脚踩在沙上，像两根柱子。
lines.en: Your two feet stand on the sand like pillars.

lines.zh: 你靠这么近，我的饼边都卷起来了。
lines.en: You come so close my pancake rim curls up.

lines.zh: 我在想，你手上有没有那种贝壳。
lines.en: I am wondering whether that shell is in your hand.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，谁也不说话。
lines.en: You look at me, I look at you, and neither speaks.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，水就一下凉了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and the water turns cold.

lines.zh: 这张平脸藏不住任何表情。
lines.en: This flat face of mine can hide no expression.

lines.zh: 我抬高一边的鳍，算是在打招呼。
lines.en: I lift one fin, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的样子，很像一只海龟。
lines.en: Crouching like that, you look much like a turtle.

lines.zh: 我记住你的靴子，不记住你的脸。
lines.en: I remember your boots, not your face.

lines.zh: 别用棍子戳我，我不会翻过来。
lines.en: Do not poke me with a stick; I will not roll over.

lines.zh: 你划开我的边沿，汁水混进了海水。
lines.en: You slice my rim and my juice mixes with seawater.

lines.zh: 我整条蜷起来，像被翻面的饼。
lines.en: I curl up whole like a pancake flipped over.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我不叫，只是鼓起来。
lines.en: In pain I make no sound; I only swell.

lines.zh: 伤口会自己长平，你别急着看。
lines.en: The wound will even out; do not rush to look.

lines.zh: 我往沙里钻，只露出受伤那一边。
lines.en: I dig into sand, showing only the wounded side.

lines.zh: 这一下让我漏了很多气。
lines.en: That blow let a great deal of air out of me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在打颤，游不动了。
lines.en: My fins tremble and I can no longer swim.

lines.zh: 血在温水里散开，像一层油。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the warm water like a film of oil.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我快摊不住了。
lines.en: Not another one; I can barely hold my shape.

lines.zh: 我疼得贴住石头，一动不动。
lines.en: I press against a stone and go completely still.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西一抖，我就游过来了。
lines.en: One twitch in your hand and I swim over.

lines.zh: 喂我一口，我给你一枚天气贝壳。
lines.en: Feed me once and I give you a weather shell.

lines.zh: 别晃那只桶，我闻得到里面的腥。
lines.en: Stop shaking that bucket; I smell the fish inside.

lines.zh: 我闻到鱼腥，整张饼都活过来了。
lines.en: I smell fish and the whole pancake comes alive.

lines.zh: 放下食物，退半步，我才敢吃。
lines.en: Set the food down, step back, and then I dare eat.

lines.zh: 我吃过一次好东西，记了一整年。
lines.en: I ate well once and remembered it a whole year.

lines.zh: 你的手太近，我先绕着转两圈。
lines.en: Your hand is too close; let me circle it twice.

lines.zh: 一枚贝壳换一顿饭，这买卖我做。
lines.en: A shell for a meal: that is a trade I make.

lines.zh: 我肚子贴着沙，等你的手松开。
lines.en: Belly to sand, I wait for your fingers to open.

lines.zh: 食物落水的声音，比什么都好听。
lines.en: Food hitting water is the loveliest sound there is.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我像垫子一样陷下去。
lines.en: You bump me and I sink in like a cushion.

lines.zh: 我的身体太软，撞完自己弹回来。
lines.en: My body is so soft it springs back after the hit.

lines.zh: 别把脚放在我背上，你会滑。
lines.en: Do not rest your foot on my back; you will slip.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是被踩扁了一点。
lines.en: I am not hurt, only flattened a little.

lines.zh: 你的靴底沾走我身上一片黏液。
lines.en: Your sole carries away a patch of my slime.

lines.zh: 我贴着你小腿滑过去，像块湿布。
lines.en: I slide past your calf like a wet cloth.

lines.zh: 这一挤，我半张脸都陷进沙里。
lines.en: That squeeze pushes half my face into the sand.

lines.zh: 我被撞翻，肚皮朝上，很丢脸。
lines.en: Knocked belly-up, I feel thoroughly ashamed.

lines.zh: 你退开，我慢慢把自己摊平。
lines.en: You step away and I slowly flatten myself again.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我吐出一小口气泡。
lines.en: The bump makes me release one small bubble.

lines.zh: 我们两条饼叠在一起，像一摞早餐。
lines.en: Two pancakes stacked, we look like breakfast.

lines.zh: 我只在水最暖的那几天找伴。
lines.en: I seek a mate only on the warmest days.

lines.zh: 交配完我们各游各的，谁都不欠谁。
lines.en: Afterward we part ways and owe each other nothing.

lines.zh: 我拍沙，把卵藏进最细的沙里。
lines.en: I slap the sand and hide eggs in the finest grains.

lines.zh: 另有一条愿意挨着我，我就够了。
lines.en: One other willing to lie beside me is enough.

lines.zh: 我的鳍碰到它的鳍，就算说好了。
lines.en: My fin touches theirs and the matter is settled.

lines.zh: 太冷了，我们连靠近的力气都没有。
lines.en: Too cold: we lack even the strength to draw near.

lines.zh: 卵在沙里，我不看着它们长大。
lines.en: The eggs stay in sand; I never watch them grow.

lines.zh: 伴侣走的时候，沙上留了印子。
lines.en: When my mate leaves, a print remains in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把身体摊开，让它看见我多大。
lines.en: I spread myself wide to show how large I am.

lines.zh: 我拾不起东西，我的鳍只会拨沙。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; my fins only push sand.

lines.zh: 那枚贝壳卡在我边沿，甩不掉。
lines.en: That shell is stuck to my rim and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起一块石头，又掉了。
lines.en: I lift a stone in my mouth and drop it again.

lines.zh: 沙里的东西我都当食物试一口。
lines.en: I try a bite of anything I find in the sand.

lines.zh: 有人把我整条捞起来，我还在呼吸。
lines.en: Someone scoops me up whole; I am still breathing.

lines.zh: 我怀里藏着一枚备用的小贝壳。
lines.en: I keep a spare little shell tucked beneath me.

lines.zh: 沉下去的东西，我都替他收着。
lines.en: Whatever sinks, I keep it for its owner.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很小，只能含一颗海葡萄。
lines.en: My mouth is small; it holds one sea grape.

lines.zh: 别把东西丢在水里，我会吞下去。
lines.en: Do not drop things in the water; I will swallow them.

lines.zh: 我拖着一片破渔网，走了很远。
lines.en: I drag a torn net a long way before stopping.

lines.zh: 有水花乱了，我就扭过头去看。
lines.en: When the water breaks, I turn my head to look.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是掉进水里的虫子。
lines.en: What I fix on is the bug that fell in.

lines.zh: 你手上的血腥味，比人更明显。
lines.en: The blood on your hands smells stronger than you.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我只追会逃的小东西。
lines.en: I chase no people, only small things that flee.

lines.zh: 一条鱼游进我的沙圈，我记住了。
lines.en: A fish enters my sand ring and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我没什么恶意，只是好奇得厉害。
lines.en: I mean no harm; I am only terribly curious.

lines.zh: 别拍水，我会以为有东西在挣扎。
lines.en: Do not slap the water; I will think something struggles.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛转过去，动静在那里。
lines.en: I turn my eyes; the noise is over there.

lines.zh: 这个目标太小，我一口就能收下。
lines.en: This target is small enough for a single bite.

lines.zh: 我只在饿的时候才理会别的生物。
lines.en: Only when hungry do I pay other creatures mind.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙跟着，等你低头那一刻。
lines.en: I follow along the sand, waiting for you to look down.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，不是偷袭，是避光。
lines.en: I circle behind you to avoid the light, not to strike.

lines.zh: 我盯得很稳，因为我的脸不会转。
lines.en: My stare is steady because my face cannot turn.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，一口够不够得着。
lines.en: I am measuring whether one bite will reach.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就把身体压低半分。
lines.en: When you move, I press myself half an inch lower.

lines.zh: 我的目标是那个晃来晃去的影子。
lines.en: My target is that shadow swaying back and forth.

lines.zh: 别跑，你一跑整片沙都扬起来了。
lines.en: Do not run; running lifts the whole seabed.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，快起来反而追不上。
lines.en: I creep slowly; speeding up only loses the trail.

lines.zh: 我在等他离水草远一点再动。
lines.en: I wait for him to leave the weeds before moving.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛不眨，所以你更紧张。
lines.en: These eyes never blink, which is why you tense.

lines.zh: 我拿整张身子拍过去，很没力道。
lines.en: I slap my whole body at you with little force.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，然后被拖走。
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg and get dragged along.

lines.zh: 这一撞像被湿毛巾抽了一下。
lines.en: This blow feels like a wet towel snapping.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，只有一圈硬边。
lines.en: I have no teeth, only a hard rim.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，随即后悔了。
lines.en: I lunge, and regret it immediately.

lines.zh: 我的攻击是把沙扬进你眼睛。
lines.en: My attack is throwing sand into your eyes.

lines.zh: 别笑，我这一口也能留下红印。
lines.en: Do not laugh; my bite still leaves a red mark.

lines.zh: 我撞完就滑开，怕你回手。
lines.en: After the hit I slide away, afraid you will swing back.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫你的脚踝，很轻。
lines.en: I sweep your ankle with my tail, very lightly.

lines.zh: 打不过的时候，我就贴地装石头。
lines.en: When losing, I lie flat and pretend to be a stone.

lines.zh: 我在温水的沙沟里出生，独自一条。
lines.en: I am born alone in a warm-water sand trench.

lines.zh: 这片海给了我形状，像一张饼。
lines.en: This sea gave me my shape, that of a pancake.

lines.zh: 海水变暖的第一天，我摊开在沙上。
lines.en: On the first warm day, I spread out on the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的阴影里滑出来。
lines.en: I slide out from the shadow of a sunken hull.

lines.zh: 没有同类迎我，我早习惯了。
lines.en: No kin came to meet me; I am used to that.

lines.zh: 我落进珊瑚的缝里，刚好卡住。
lines.en: I drop into a coral crevice and fit exactly.

lines.zh: 暖流把我从远处带来，我留下了。
lines.en: A warm current carried me here, and I stayed.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，看见的是海面的光。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was light on the surface.

lines.zh: 我的第一条记忆是沙的味道。
lines.en: My first memory is the taste of sand.

lines.zh: 这片海湾很浅，正好放得下我。
lines.en: This bay is shallow, just enough to hold me.

lines.zh: 水面上的火一烧，我的边沿就焦了。
lines.en: Fire on the water scorches my rim black.

lines.zh: 被甩出水面，我拍在礁石上。
lines.en: Flung from the water, I slap onto the reef.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的两片鳃黏成了一片。
lines.en: Out of water, my two gills stick together.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，饼边全碎了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and shatters my rim.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我身上，薄得像一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow pins me, thin as a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我整个人发麻。
lines.en: The potion's smell numbs my entire body.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我薄得能透光。
lines.en: Starved long enough, I am thin enough to see through.

lines.zh: 雷打进浅水，我被震得直翻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows and flips me over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的形状散了。
lines.en: There is no water in the void, and my shape dissolves.
